verdict.rationale: The project's own README points users to an in-browser playground to try code, and community users mention a playground widget and runnable examples on the Solid site. Together these show a hands-on, no-setup environment, but no evidence describes a structured, guided interactive tutorial. Users also reported the playground misbehaving and examples failing to load on Android Chrome, which undercuts the experience without contradicting that it exists. Missing for 10: evidence of a guided step-by-step interactive tutorial, first-party documentation of its lesson content, reliable cross-device behavior.
